rows.behavior: Model gateway: modes, kill switch, key, budget pre-check, daily cap and call log

claims.claim: The gateway is the only code that calls a model
Checks in order: kill switch, mode, key, budget
Kill switch FIRSTCALL_MODEL_OFF stops every call
Daily cap per org and UTC day, default $1.00
Spend is kept per org and day in the budget ledger
Worst-case cost (prompt plus full-length answer) is reserved before a call
A call that could take the day past the cap is refused
The real cost replaces the reservation after the call
A failed attempt keeps its reservation; the ledger reads high, never low
Model down means two attempts failed
offline is the default mode and makes no calls
Offline gives no answer, so the message is marked needs_reread
Replay answers are keyed by SHA-256 of model, system prompt, user message and schema
Record mode refuses input not from the synthetic generator
Only tests use a fake model
The model is off by default (FIRSTCALL_MODEL_MODE=offline), so no key is needed
A call whose prompt is over 100,000 tokens is charged the higher rates on all its tokens
Long tier above 100,000 tokens at $0.50 and $2.50
Only Claude models on the Anthropic API are wired
An unreadable answer is charged (a cut answer comes back with its tokens and empty text)

rows.behavior: Model read and per-field method choice

claims.claim: An email is shown as From, Reply-To, To, Subject and Date plus decoded body text
A form or call post is shown as its JSON
Unless category's method is model, a rules-spam message is not sent
Unreadable: not a JSON object, wrong type, or a value outside its list
rules, model and combined methods; combined keeps rules unless empty or unsure
A rules spam signal still decides the category under combined
With no answer the rules read stands and the message is marked needs_reread
DEFAULT_METHODS applies when config/field_methods.yaml is missing

rows.behavior: No-model fallback and the reread job

claims.claim: The scheduler's tick rereads needs_reread messages
A reread fills only empty fields and never a person's edit
A phone or email becomes an identity only if no other lead holds it
A not-a-lead answer flags the lead for the monitor
Only messages that created a lead are reread
model_unavailable can also hold set_aside or 'error: <type>' from the reread job
